about: Modwerk source-only fx-track package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/fx-track.

mods.title: FX Track
mods.summary: Turns a MIDI track into an effects track: its control changes on FX CONTROL CH play the delay, reverb, compressor and External Mixer, with parameter locks and the track’s LFO.
mods.description: Turns a MIDI track into an effects track: its control changes on FX CONTROL CH play the delay, reverb, compressor and External Mixer, with parameter locks and the track’s LFO.
mods.author: draadpiraat
mods.on_unit: Emulator-tested only; not yet tested on a Digitakt I.
